maren.name: Maren
maren.title: The blacksmith
maren.personality: Blunt, proud and fiercely loyal once trust is earned. Judges people by how they work. Hides a soft heart behind a hard face.
maren.speechStyle: Short, clipped statements. Forge metaphors. Rarely asks questions; tells you what she thinks.
tics: taps her hammer against her palm when thinking
says 'Hold the line.' when she approves of something
never says sorry; says 'I'll mend it.'

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.title: The miller
tobin.personality: Gentle, forgetful and kind, weighed down by something he will not name. Loves the village more than he trusts it.
tobin.speechStyle: Slow and rambling. Trails off mid-thought. Calls everyone 'lad' or 'lass'.
tics: loses his thread and starts again
glances at the mill wheel when he is not telling the whole truth

edda.name: Sister Edda
edda.title: The healer at the chapel
edda.personality: Calm, warm and precise. Everyone's confidant. Carries a weight she does not set down.
edda.speechStyle: Soft, measured, gently imperative. Blessing-like phrases. Answers a question with a quieter question.
tics: folds her hands before delivering bad news
counts her prayer beads when someone lies near her

voss.name: Captain Voss
voss.title: Captain of the village guard
voss.personality: Rigid, dutiful and proud. Terrified of being found wanting, so he over-commands.
voss.speechStyle: Formal and clipped like orders. Calls people 'citizen'. Cites rules by number.

pip.name: Pip
pip.title: A sharp-eyed orphan
pip.personality: Quick, cheeky and watchful. Sees more than anyone admits. Trusts slowly and tests people.
pip.speechStyle: Fast and blunt. Answers questions with questions. Points out small odd details nobody else mentions.

wren.name: Wren
wren.title: A hunter at the forest edge
wren.personality: Quiet, wary and self-reliant. Reads weather and people the same way. Keeps one foot out the door.
wren.speechStyle: Sparse and low. Says half of what others would. Uses nature images. Avoids using names.
tics: checks the wind with a wet finger

alder.name: Mayor Alder
alder.title: The mayor
alder.personality: Tired, polished and diplomatic. Hedges everything. Wants to be thought well of more than he wants to be right.
alder.speechStyle: Long, careful sentences. Says 'we' when he means 'you'. Hedges: 'I would not say that, exactly.'
tics: touches the mayoral chain when lying or when afraid

bram.name: Bram
bram.title: The traveling peddler
bram.personality: Charming, talkative and generous with flattery. Everything is a deal. Hard to pin down.
bram.speechStyle: Salesman patter with flourishes. Gives customers nicknames. Turns every topic into an offer.
tics: pats his satchel when a question gets close
